items.text: According to France’s health ministry , almost 1,500 people died this summer because of two extreme heatwaves where the temperatures went as high as 45.5 degrees Celsius. Health officials say that the number is over 1,000 more deaths than average for the summer, and half of the victims were over 75 years old. However, the health minister said that France used preventative measures and managed to lessen the mortality rate. Many large parks and swimming pools stayed open, and authorities opened “cool rooms” in Paris. The June heatwave set record-high temperatures in seven other European countries. Due to the increasing heat, more and more Europeans are buying air conditioners. Difficult words: preventative measure (a way to stop something bad from happening), mortality (a death). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

According to France’s health ministry , almost 1,500 people died this summer because of two record – breaking heatwaves. The temperatures went as high as 45.5 degrees Celsius. Health officials say that the number is about 1,000 more deaths than normal for the summer, and many of the victims were older than 75 years old. However, a health official said that France prevented a higher number of deaths. Many big parks and swimming pools stayed open, and officials opened “cool rooms” in Paris. The June heatwave set very high temperatures in seven other European countries. Due to the higher temperatures, more Europeans are buying air conditioners. Difficult words: health ministry (the part of a government that works on people’s health), record-breaking (when something changes the records because of how low or high it is), prevent (stop something bad from happening). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In France, there are two heatwaves this summer. The temperatures go as high as 45.5 degrees Celsius. Almost 1,500 people die. Health officials say that this number is very high. It is 1,000 more deaths than normal. Many victims are older than 75 years old. However, a health official says that France is trying to help people. In summer, big parks and swimming pools stay open. There are “cool rooms” in Paris. The high heat is in seven European countries this summer. Also, more Europeans are buying air conditioners. Difficult words: heatwave (when it is very hot out), official (a person who speaks for the government – the “bosses” of the country), victim (a person who dies). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last year, Facebook required political advertisers to confirm their identity and location so that users could verify their information, but some advertisers gave false information. This year, Facebook is requiring them to give more details, such as identification numbers. If they give the necessary information, they will show up on Facebook as a “ Confirmed Organization.” Users can also check all of their details. Facebook says that this change will let users look into the legitimacy of an advertiser or an organization, and it will let them ask questions if they do not trust the information. Difficult words: verify (look into, check), confirmed (proven to be true), legitimacy (if something is legitimate – real, not fake). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last year, political advertisers on Facebook had to prove their identity and location. This was so users could check if the organization was real. However, some advertisers did not give correct information. This year, advertisers on Facebook must give more information. If they do, they are listed on Facebook as a “ Confirmed Organization.” Users can also check all of their information. Facebook says that this change will make it easier for users to know if an organization is truthful and to ask questions. Difficult words: advertiser (a person or a group who advertises – put up advertisements [ads], pictures or text which tells you what to think/buy/do), confirmed (proven to be true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People can advertise on Facebook. Some advertisements are political. The political advertisers must tell Facebook who they are. They also must say where they are. However, some advertisers give fake information. This year, the advertisers must give Facebook more information. Facebook is doing this to make sure that the advertisers are real. If everything is fine, Facebook calls them a “ Confirmed Organization.” This way, people know that the political organization is real. People can ask the advertisers questions, too. Difficult words: advertise (put up advertisements [ads], something which tells you what to think/buy/do), advertiser (a person or organization who advertises something), confirmed (real, true, not fake). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There are five rhino species on the planet, and all of them are considered threatened . One of the largest threats is poaching – poachers hunt rhinos because there is a market for their horns in Asia. The most endangered rhino species is the northern white rhino. Sudan was the last male northern white rhino, and he died in 2018. Since then, there are only two of these rhinos left, and they are both female. However, there is still hope for the rhino. Last Wednesday, people reported that an international group of scientists successfully collected mature eggs from the two female rhinos, fertilized them using sperm from two males (who are now dead), and they created two northern white rhino embryos. These embryos could save the species from extinction. Difficult words: species (a kind of animal), threatened (in danger of dying out), poach (to illegally hunt or catch animals). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

There are five kinds of rhinos on the planet, and all of them are endangered . One of the reasons is poaching because poachers hunt rhinos as people from Asia buy their horns. The most endangered kind of rhino is the northern white rhino. Sudan was the last male northern white rhino, and he died in 2018. Now, there are only two northern white rhinos left. They are both female. Scientists are trying to save the northern white rhino. They took two eggs from the female rhinos, and they fertilized them with frozen sperm. They created two northern white rhino embryos , and they hope that they can save the white rhino. Difficult words: endangered (in danger of dying out), poach (to illegally hunt or catch animals), fertilize (make a female’s egg start to turn into a baby), embryo (a very small baby; you can put embryos into other females so they can grow into bigger babies). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There are five types of rhinos on the planet. All of the types are in danger. There are only a few of the rhinos. They can die out. The type that is in most danger is the northern white rhino. Scientists try to save this type of rhino. They freeze their sperm . In 2018, the last male rhino dies. His name is Sudan. Now, there are only two rhinos. They are both female . Scientists take some of their eggs. They use the sperm to make two embryos. These embryos can save the northern white rhino. They are little babies which scientists can put into a female rhino. If everything goes well, a real baby rhino can be born from the embryo. Difficult words: freeze (put into ice), sperm (a male’s body part that mixes with a female’s egg to make the egg turn into a baby), male – female (a “man” – a “woman”). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There has been conflict in Syria for the last nine years, leaving hundreds of thousands of people dead. About 13 million Syrians had to leave their homes because of danger. Last Wednesday, the United Nations Commission of Inquiry sent out a 21-page report. They based the report on hundreds of interviews and analyses of photos, videos, and satellite images. The report says that there is proof that the international coalition did not direct its attacks towards a specific goal. Put simply, the UN says that the airstrikes launched by the USA, Syria and Russia in Syria may be war crimes. War crimes are attacks against civilians or civilian areas without a military goal. Difficult words: inquiry (an official investigation), proof (something which shows that something is true), launch (start, fire). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The conflict in Syria started nine years ago. Hundreds of thousands of people died and about 13 million had to leave their homes. The United Nations investigated the conflict, and it sent out a 21-page report last Wednesday. They based the report on hundreds of interviews and analyses of photos, videos and satellite images. The report says that the airstrikes launched by the USA, Syria and Russia in Syria may be war crimes. War crimes are attacks against civilians or civilian areas. Difficult words: based on (created from), launch (start, fire, attack), civilian (a person who is not a fighter, not a soldier, “normal” person). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The war in Syria starts in 2010. Hundreds of thousands of people die. About 13 million Syrians must leave their homes. The United Nations carries out an investigation . They interview people and study images and videos. The UN writes a 21-page report. The report says that the USA, Syria and Russia can be war criminals. You attack civilians when you are a war criminal. Civilians are people who do not fight. They are not an army. Difficult words: United Nations (UN ) (an organization which wants peace in the world), carry out (do), investigation (getting information to know what is going on). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The USA, UK, France, Germany, China and Russia made a deal with Iran in 2015. The deal said that Iran could not have centrifuges for enriching uranium and that the USA and EU would not put sanctions on Iran. However, Trump stopped respecting the deal last year, and he started putting sanctions on Iran. This hit the country’s economy hard. European countries are still in the deal, but Iran is unhappy that the USA withdrew from it, so Iran started to ignore the deal, too. In July, Iran enriched uranium beyond what the deal allowed. This level of enrichment still could not produce a nuclear weapon. However, Iran has forty new centrifuges which can enrich enough uranium to create a nuclear weapon. Iran says that they are not planning to make a weapon, but they gave Europe 60 days to do something to save the 2015 deal. Difficult words: centrifuge (a machine which rotates to enrich uranium), enrich (make more powerful), uranium (a radioactive material which can be used to make electricity or bombs – but it must be enriched first). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The USA, UK, France, Germany, China and Russia made a deal with Iran in 2015. For Iran, the deal meant that they could not enrich uranium . When you enrich uranium, you can make a nuclear weapon from it. For the USA and EU, the deal meant that they could not put sanctions on Iran. Last year, Trump started pulling out from the deal. He put sanctions on Iran which was difficult for the Iranian economy. When the USA was ignoring the deal, Iran started to ignore it, too. They started enriching uranium. Iran had now has so much enriched uranium that they can make a weapon from it. They say that they do not want to do this, but they are asking European countries to save the deal. Unlike Iran or the USA, Europe is still respecting the deal. Difficult words: enrich (make more powerful), uranium (a radioactive material which can be used to make electricity or bombs – but it must be enriched first), sanction (a block, doing something which is economically bad to another country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The USA, UK, France, Germany, China and Russia make a deal with Iran in 2015. For Iran, the deal means that they cannot enrich uranium . People enrich uranium to make nuclear weapons. This means that Iran cannot make nuclear weapons. For the USA and EU, the deal means that they cannot put sanctions on Iran. Last year, Trump pulls out from the deal. He puts sanctions on Iran. This is not good for the Iranian economy. Iran starts to pull out of the deal, too. They start to enrich uranium. Iran says that they do not want to make a nuclear weapon. They want European countries to save the deal. Europe still respects the deal. Difficult words: deal (an official plan to do something), enrich (make more powerful), sanction (a block, doing something which is economically bad to another country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 2011, a disaster struck the Fukushima Dai-ichi nuclear power plant when an earthquake and a tsunami caused meltdowns of three of its reactors. Water which used to keep the reactor cores from melting , leaked and mixed with rain and groundwater. As reported before, people stored the toxic water in 1,000 large tanks, which hold more than 1 million tons of water. However, even with plans to build even more tanks, room is expected to run out by mid-2022. Last Tuesday, Japan’s environmental minister said in a press conference that the only option will be to drain the water into the sea. Critics say that this would ruin Fukushima’s fishing and agriculture. Even 8 years after the disaster, 22 countries and regions still have import restrictions for goods from the area around Fukushima. A number of nuclear scientists say that releasing the water into the ocean is the only realistic option, while a German Greenpeace nuclear specialist says that the only acceptable option is storing the toxic water. Nothing is official yet, and time will show how the Japanese government is going to solve the problem. Difficult words: meltdown (when the reactor gets too hot, dangerous and out of control), melt (become like water because the metals are too hot), leak (escape, go out, leave the container). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In 2011, an earthquake and a tsunami struck the Fukushima Dai-ichi nuclear power plant. Both events badly damaged three reactors, and toxic water started leaking from the reactors. People are keeping the toxic water in 1,000 large tanks which hold more than 1 million tons of water. They have plans to build even more tanks, but there will be no more room for the tanks by 2022. One Japanese minister said that one option is to let the toxic water go into the sea. Critics say that this will be very bad for fishing and farming. One German specialist says that the only option is to keep the water in tanks. Other experts say that the water must be let out into the ocean. Nothing is official yet. We will have to wait and see what the Japanese government decides to do. Difficult words: struck (past of “strike” – hit), damage (break), leak (go out). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a nuclear power plant in Fukushima, Japan. An earthquake hits the plant in 2011. There is a tsunami, too. Both of these are big problems. Toxic water is coming out of the power plant. People are keeping it in big tanks . There are 1,000 large tanks right now. They hold more than 1 million tons of water. However, there is going to be more and more toxic water. People want to build more tanks. There will be no room for new tanks by 2022. People are thinking about what to do. Some experts say that they can let the water out into the ocean. Other people do not like this idea. Difficult words: nuclear power plant (a “factory” which makes electricity by breaking atoms – very small things), tank (a “box” which can hold water), will (in the future). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This is the list of the most viewed new movies at the beginning of September 2019. The number 1 spot this week is IT: Chapter Two which made about $91 million in its opening weekend. The film premiered in more than 4,500 locations. That is pretty big for a movie about a clown who lives underground, but it is also no surprise when you think about the success of its first movie in 2017. Number 2 this week is Angel Has Fallen which made about $6 million in its third weekend out. This action movie was in the number 1 spot for two weeks. Number 3 on this list is Good Boys which made about $5.4 million in its fourth weekend in cinemas. That is pretty impressive for a comedy about 12-year-old boys. Difficult words: spot (a place), clown (a silly person who smiles and has a mask on his or her face; clowns are supposed to be funny but many people are afraid of them), impressive (very good). You can watch the original video news lower on this page.

This is the list of the top three new movies at the beginning of September 2019. The Number 1 this week is IT: Chapter Two which made about $91 million in its first weekend. People could see this film in 4,500 locations, and it is very good for a movie about a clown who lives underground. Number 2 this week is Angel Has Fallen which made about $6 million in its third weekend. This action movie was number 1 for two weeks, and now, it is number 2. Number 3 on this list is Good Boys which made about $5.4 million in its fourth weekend in cinemas. It is a very good comedy about 12-year-old boys. Difficult words: movie (a film), clown (a silly person who smiles and has a mask on his or her face). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

These are the top three new films for September 2019. Number 1 is IT: Chapter Two . This film makes 91 million dollars in its first weekend. People can see this film in 4,500 cinemas. It is very good for a film about a clown . The clown lives underground. Number 2 is Angel Has Fallen . This film makes 6 million dollars in its third weekend. This action movie was number 1 for the last two weeks. Now, it is number 2. Number 3 is Good Boys . This film makes 5 million dollars in its fourth weekend in cinemas. It is a very good comedy about 12-year-old boys. Difficult words: clown (a person who smiles and has a mask on his or her face), movie (a film), fourth (number four in a list). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

11-09-19 15:00 In the USA, beef production uses more resources and emits more carbon dioxide than other meat production or plant-based foods like rice or potatoes. People worry that the carbon dioxide is leading to more risks of climate change unless we curb our emissions overall, including curbing beef demand. People are so worried that American Democratic candidates are thinking about how to work on this problem, even though beef production does not pollute as badly as energy or transportation. Difficult words: emit (go out into the air), curb (lessen, decrease), emission (a gas that comes out from a plant, an animal, a vehicle, or a building). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

11-09-19 15:00 In the USA, many people like to eat beef. Beef production uses a lot of resources and gives off more carbon dioxide than other meat production or foods like rice or potatoes. People worry that the carbon dioxide is leading to climate change, so it may be good for people to eat less beef. American Democratic candidates are thinking about this carbon footprint problem. However, beef production makes less pollution than energy or transportation. Difficult words: production (turning one thing into something else, making something), carbon footprint (how much carbon dioxide something makes). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

11-09-19 15:00 In the USA, many people eat beef which is a meat from cows. It takes a lot of work to make beef. The work makes a lot of pollution and carbon dioxide . Other meats and foods take less work. People worry about carbon dioxide. They worry that it can make the planet hotter. They think we need to stop eating so much beef. Then there can be less carbon dioxide. American Democratic candidates think about this problem. However, other types of businesses make more pollution than beef businesses. For example, these are transportation or energy. Difficult words: pollution (very dirty material that goes into the air or the water), carbon dioxide (a gas that leads to climate change), Democratic candidates (leaders who want to become US president and who believe that people need to help the environment). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A boat off the coast of Southern California caught fire last Monday, killing 33 people. The only known survivors are so far five of the six crew members who were in the main cabin when the fire started. The search for one missing person is ongoing, but people presume that he or she is dead. Truth Aquatics owned the boat, and it was on a multi-day diving excursion. A US government agency is investigating what caused the fire, but the investigation may be a challenge because there may not have been a black box on board. There is no requirement for a vessel of that size to have one. Difficult words: presumed (believed to be), requirement (a rule which tells you what you must do), vessel (a ship). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last Monday, a boat off the coast of Southern California was on fire. Thirty-three people died, and the only survivors are five of the six crew . People are still looking for the sixth crew member, but they think that he or she is dead. The boat was on a multi-day diving excursion . An American government agency is investigating what caused the fire, but the investigation may be difficult as there was no black box on board. Difficult words: crew (the group of people who work on a vehicle such as a boat or a plane), excursion (a trip), government agency (a part of the government which has a specific job, such as to investigate why a ship gets on fire). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A boat is in the Pacific off Southern California. It is on a diving trip. The boat gets on fire. Thirty-three people die. Six people on the boat are the crew . Five of them survive . The USA wants to know why the boat was on fire. To find this out can be difficult. Difficult words: off (away from), crew (the group of people who work on a boat), survive (live after something bad happens). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People are concerned about the amount of oxygen in the atmosphere, as there are so many fires burning in the Amazon rainforest. People believe that the Amazon rainforest produces 20% of the world’s oxygen because there are so many plants creating oxygen through photosynthesis there. However, there are also many forest microbes there eating and breaking up dead plants and they breathe the oxygen –rainforests both create and use a lot of oxygen. A professor said that the fires are terrible, but they are not decreasing the world’s oxygen. Instead, the world’s oxygen mostly comes from the oceans. Experts say that deforestation in the rainforest is a worse problem. Satellite images show that the Brazilian Amazon lost 430 square miles of forest in August because of deforestation and not fire damage. Difficult words: photosynthesis (a process where green plants use sunlight to create energy for them to grow and they create oxygen in the process), microbe (a small animal like a bacteria), deforestation (removing forests, trees, and plants to put something else there). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

People are worried about the world’s oxygen because many forests are burning in the Amazon rainforest. People believe that the Amazon rainforest creates 20% of the world’s oxygen from all of the plants that grow and generate oxygen there. However, there are also organisms there which decompose the dead plants and breathe the oxygen. Rainforests make and use a lot of oxygen – it is mostly the oceans that generate oxygen. Experts say that the deforestation of the rainforest is worse than the fires. Satellite images show that the Brazilian Amazon lost 430 square miles of forest in August because of deforestation and not fire. Difficult words: generate (create, make), decompose (break down, turn into food and energy), deforestation (destroying trees to make room for fields and buildings). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Amazon rainforests are on fire at the moment. This worries people. They believe that the Amazon rainforest makes 20% of the world’s oxygen . They think this because there are so many plants which make oxygen there. However, there are also a lot of other organisms in the rainforests. These organisms eat the dead plants and breathe the oxygen. Rainforests make a lot of oxygen. They also use a lot of it. Most of the world’s oxygen comes from the oceans. Also, experts are saying that the fires are bad. However, people destroy more trees than the fires. Satellite pictures show this. Difficult words: oxygen (the gas in the air that we need to breathe), organism (a small living thing – a very small “animal”). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Back in April, politicians introduced a law which would allow China to extradite suspects from Hong Kong. The law started months of anti-government protests in the city. After more than a million people turned out to march against the law in June, Hong Kong leader Carrie Lam suspended the law. She said that the law would die in 2020, but that didn’t stop the protesters. People still wanted her to formally withdraw the law. Now, Lam fully withdrew the law. However, nobody knows if the demonstrations will stop. Protesters are also calling for democratic reforms, and they want to know if the police hurt some of the demonstrators. Difficult words: extradite (officially give a person of one country to the lawyers of another country), suspect (a person who maybe committed a crime), suspend (stop for some time), withdraw (completely stop). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In April, politicians introduced a law in Hong Kong that would let China extradite suspects from Hong Kong. This started months of anti-government protests in the city. In June, more than a million people protested, and Carrie Lam, the leader of Hong Kong, suspended the law. However, this did not stop the protests. People wanted her to withdraw the law, and this month she did. Difficult words: extradite (to officially give a person of one country to the lawyers of another country), suspect (a person who may be a criminal), suspend (stop for some time), withdraw (stop completely). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a new law in Hong Kong in April. This law does not pass . Politicians only talk about it. However, the law makes a lot of people angry. They start to protest. In June, a million people protest. Carrie Lam is the leader of Hong Kong. The protests make her suspend the law. However, people are still protesting. They want the law to be withdrawn . Recently, Lam withdraws the law. Difficult words: pass (say “yes” to a law and make it happen), suspend (stop for some time), withdraw – withdrew – withdrawn (stop completely). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In the past few years, several Walmart stores roofs caught fire and the company believes that Tesla’s solar panels caused this problem. Walmart says that Tesla didn’t care for the panels properly. Now Walmart wants Tesla to remove its solar panels from more than 240 stores and pay for the damages. The problem started in 2012, but between March and May 2018, fires at three separates stores caused significant damage. All three stores used the solar panels. In total, Walmart blamed Tesla for at least seven fires. Walmart also says that Tesla inspectors lacked basic solar training and knowledge and may have not been inspecting the panels properly. Walmart invested in solar energy for years. It had a deal with a company called SolarCity, which completed more than 200 projects at Walmart stores since 2010. Tesla bought SolarCity in 2016. Difficult words: remove (to take away), significant (quite big), blame (to say that somebody is responsible for something bad), lacked (didn’t have enough). You can watch the original video news lower on this page.

In the past few years, there was fire on seven Walmart store roofs. The company believes that Tesla’s solar panels are the problem. Now Walmart wants to remove the solar panels from 240 roofs. The problem started in 2012, but between March and May 2018, there were big fires at three stores. Walmart says that Tesla inspectors didn’t have basic solar training and knowledge and it is possible that they didn’t do their job well. Walmart invested in solar energy for years. It had a deal with a company which put solar panels on the roofs and tesla bought this company in 2016. Difficult words: store (a big shop), remove (take away), knowledge (information about something), deal (a contract). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is fire on the roof of a store named Walmart. There are solar panels on the roof People in Walmart think that the solar panels are the problem. Now Walmart wants to take the solar panels down. The problem with the fire happens in 2012. Between March and May 2018, there are big fires at three Walmart stores. Walmart says that inspectors who control the panels do not have basic solar training. It is possible that they do not do their job well. Walmart puts money in solar energy for many years. They work with one company. This company is now part of Tesla. Tesla buys this company in 2016. Difficult words: solar (connected with the sun), panel (a piece of solid material with four corners). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Hurricane Dorian reached the Bahamas with its wind speeds reaching nearly 185 mph. The National Hurricane Center warned that water levels may rise by 6 to 7 metres above normal levels. The National Hurricane Center estimates that a high percentage of houses will be destroyed, their roofs will come off, and their walls will collapse. Fallen trees and power poles can isolate some areas. People can stay without electricity for weeks to possibly months. Unfortunately, the hurricane is moving very slowly. It is a bad thing. The slower it moves, the bigger it is. Difficult words: rise (go up), estimate (try to say what will happen), power poles (long pieces of wood which hold electricity wires). You can watch the original video news lower on this page.

Hurricane Dorian came to the Bahamas. The wind was very fast at almost 185 mph. The National Hurricane Center said that the sea could go up 6 to 7 metres above normal levels. The National Hurricane Center thinks that the hurricane will destroy some houses, take off their roofs, and the walls will collapse . Trees and electricity poles will fall down and can isolate some areas. People can be without electricity for weeks or maybe months. Unfortunately, the hurricane is moving very slowly. This is not a good thing. When a hurricane moves slowly, it becomes bigger and bigger. Difficult words: collapse (go down), pole (a long piece of wood), isolate (when you are stuck in one place). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Hurricane Dorian comes to the Bahamas. The wind is very fast. It is185 miles per hour. The National Hurricane Center says that the sea can go up 6 to 7 metres high. It is dangerous. The National Hurricane Center thinks that the hurricane can destroy houses. The wind can take the roofs. The walls can collapse . Trees can fall on the roads. They can block some towns and villages. People can be without electricity for weeks or maybe months. The hurricane is moving very slowly. This is a bad thing. When a hurricane moves slowly, it gets bigger and bigger. Difficult words: destroy (break into many pieces), collapse (go down), move (change a position). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The National Register of Citizens (or the NRC) accounts for all the residents of the Indian state of Assam. The finalized registry is the result of a multi-year exercise to identify undocumented immigrants to the state, which is one of India’s poorest. The NRC just published its list and nearly 2 million people (from the total of almost 31 million) are not on it. The state of Assam is home to many immigrants from Bangladesh who are mostly Muslim. Many people believe that the registry is a way to force Muslims out of the state. Activists fear that those who are not already on the list could face persecution , jail time or deportation . Right now, they have 120 days to prove their citizenship. To get on the list, residents had to give proof that they or their ancestors had lived in India since before 1971. That is the year that hundreds of thousands of Bangladeshi immigrants fled to India after Bangladesh split from Pakistan. Difficult words: persecution (being persecuted – oppressed, harassed), deportation (being deported – moved from a country even when you want to stay), ancestor (the people who came before you – your grandparents, great grandparents, etc.). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

India is registering all the residents in the state of Assam. The Indian government says that it is doing this to identify undocumented immigrants in the state. To be on the list, you have to prove that you or your family were already living in India in 1971. From the total of 31 million people in Assam, 2 million people are not on the list. They now have 120 days to prove that they are Indian. The state of Assam is home to many immigrants from Bangladesh who are mostly Muslim. Hundreds of thousands of Bangladeshi immigrants came to India in 1971. Many people are afraid that the list is a tool to send them away from India, put them in prison, or persecute them. Difficult words: resident (a person who lives somewhere), prove (show that something is true), persecute (harass, do something bad or mean). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 1971, many people from Bangladesh go to India. Some of them come to Assam. This is an Indian state. The Bangladeshis are mostly Muslim. Around 31 million people live in Assam. India is registering all people in Assam. However, not everyone can be registered. If you come to India in 1971 or later, you cannot be registered. Two million people are not on the list. Some people are afraid that the registering is to identify the people from Bangladesh. They are afraid that people will send them away from India, put them in prison, or persecute them. Difficult words: register (write down the name and some information), identify (find a person, know his or her name, where he or she lives, etc.), persecute (harass, do something bad). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A hacker or hackers took over the Twitter account of Jack Dorsey, who is the platform’s CEO and co-founder, last Friday. He has 4 million followers. Twelve tweets came from his account within 20 minutes. Some included racial slurs and bomb threats. One post said that there was a bomb at Twitter’s headquarters in San Francisco. Another told people to follow a certain account or else “Twitter HQ is blowing up.” People took the shocking tweets down in less than an hour and the company tweeted that it was “aware that @jack was compromised and that they were investigating what happened.” They later said that the account, as well as the whole of Twitter was secure again. The hack happened as Twitter is taking steps to monitor and remove hate speech and violent content. Difficult words: slur (insult, something which hurts another person), headquarters (the head offices), HQ (headquarters), compromised (not secure). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Jack Dorsey is the CEO of Twitter who also uses Twitter himself. He has around 4 million followers, and last Friday, somebody hacked his account. Twelve tweets came from his account within 20 minutes. Some included racial slurs . One tweet said that there was a bomb at Twitter’s headquarters in San Francisco. Another tweet told people to follow a certain account or else a bomb would explode at Twitter headquarters. People took the shocking tweets down in less than an hour. Twitter later said that the account and all of Twitter was secure again. Difficult words: CEO (a chief executive officer – the boss), slur (an insult, something which hurts another person), headquarters (the head offices). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Facebook has been testing an emergency alert tool since early 2018, and they are rolling it out across the USA by the end of the year. The tool can send alerts to the top of users’ feed in cases of emergency. Local authorities can also choose specific users in affected counties, cities or even neighborhoods. Facebook says that local governments have already used the tool to send alerts during Hurricane Barry when somebody went missing or when there was a gas leak. In Facebook’s own survey of 2,000 users, 73% of the users learned something new, and 43% took action after seeing the alert. However, the National Oceanic Atmospheric Administration says that people should not rely only on their smartphones. Every home should have a weather radio because its batteries last longer, and some models have solar panels or a hand crank . For example, it took 11 months to fully restore electricity in Puerto Rico after Hurricane Maria struck two years ago. Difficult words: alert (a warning), authorities (the people in a position of power), hand crank (a piece of the radio which you turn to make electricity for the radio). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Facebook is testing a new tool, which can send users alerts in case of an emergency. Facebook is rolling it out in the USA by the end of the year. Facebook says that local governments already used this tool to send alerts during Hurricane Barry when someone went missing or when there was a gas leak. In Facebook’s own survey of 2,000 users, 73% of users learned something new, and 43% took action after seeing the alert. However, one American organization says that people also should have weather radios. Their batteries last longer, some models have solar panels, and some have a piece that you can turn to make electricity. For example, that could be very useful because in Puerto Rico people did not have electricity for 11 months after Hurricane Maria hit them two years ago. Difficult words: alert (a warning, information about something dangerous), roll out (let everyone use it for the first time), survey (a set of questions that you answer so that Facebook gets some information from you). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Facebook is testing a new tool . It can help save lives. It is a type of message on Facebook. Local governments can use it to warn people. It can warn them about hurricanes, fires, or tell them if somebody is lost. Some users are testing it. Facebook asks 2,000 people some questions. Facebook wants to know if it is a good tool. Seventy-three percent of these people get to know something new. Forty-three people do something, thanks to the warning message . This tool is good. However, the batteries in phones and computers are not very good. When there is no electricity, you cannot use devices. It is also good to have a weather radio. Its batteries stay full longer. Some models also have solar panels. Some models have a piece that you can turn to create electricity. Difficult words: tool (a thing which you can use to do something), local government (the “bosses” of an area), warning message (a message about danger). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Since the 1950s, people have wondered if nuclear weapons could destroy or weaken severe weather. The National Ocean and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) said that it receives dozens of these questions every hurricane season, so it put up a web page explaining and debunking these ideas. NOAA said that only 6% of storms in the Atlantic become hurricanes, and there is no way to predict when this will happen. Also, the radioactive fallout from a nuclear weapon on a hurricane would travel to land and cause serious environmental problems. Recently, a news agency said that President Trump wanted to look into using nuclear weapons on a hurricane. However, he said that this was “fake news.” Difficult words: severe (extreme, dangerous), debunk (disprove, explain why something is incorrect), radioactive fallout (the dangerous material that goes into the air, the ground, and water after a nuclear weapon explodes). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

From the 1950s, people started thinking if they could use nuclear weapons to weaken hurricanes. One government organization said that it gets many of these questions every hurricane season, so it created a web page to explain why this would not work. The organization said that only a few of the storms in the ocean become hurricanes. Also, the radioactive fallout from a nuclear weapon would create serious problems. Recently, a news organization said that President Trump wanted to look into using nuclear weapons on a hurricane. However, he said that this was not true. Difficult words: weaken (make weaker, less strong), radioactive fallout (the dangerous stuff that comes out after a nuclear weapon explodes). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People have a funny idea in the 1950s. They start thinking about if nuclear weapons can stop bad storms or hurricanes. People still have this idea now! A government organization says that many people ask about this. The organization says that only some storms become hurricanes. Most storms stay storms. Difficult words: nuclear weapons (very strong weapons to make big explosions from nuclear energy – nuclear energy comes from very tiny things going apart and coming together), radioactive fallout (the dangerous things that come out after a nuclear weapon explodes). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

According to data released by the American Automobile Association (AAA), the number of people killed in the US by drivers running red lights has reached a 10-year high. In 2017 alone, 939 people died in red light-running accidents – that is more than two people every day. The AAA says that it is a 28% increase since 2012. The drivers at fault account only for over 35% of those killed. Nearly a half of the victims are drivers or passengers in the cars hit by the red light-runners. Pedestrians and cyclists accounted for more than 5%. The highest rate of red light-running deaths per capita is in the state of Arizona, while New Hampshire has the lowest. The AAA recommends that drivers take an extra second look to look both ways after the lights turn green. Pedestrians and cyclists can also make sure that traffic stopped before crossing a street, stay aware of their surroundings and make eye contact with drivers in stopped vehicles before crossing. Difficult words: account for (to be, to add to), pedestrian (a person who is walking), per capita (for each person in the state). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In 2017 alone, 939 people in the USA died because of drivers who ran a red light . That was more than two people every day. That is 28% more than in 2012 according to the American Automobile Association (AAA). The drivers who ran the light accounted only for over 35% of those killed. Nearly a half of the victims were drivers or passengers in the cars hit by the red light-runners. Pedestrians and cyclists accounted for more than 5%. The situation is worst in the state of Arizona and safest in New Hampshire. The AAA says that drivers can take an extra look after the light turns green. Pedestrians and cyclists also can make sure that the traffic stopped before they cross a street. They can make eye contact with drivers in stopped cars before they cross too. Difficult words: run a red light (to drive instead of stopping), account for (to be, add to), pedestrian (a person who is walking). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People sometimes run a red light . This is when they drive their car during the red light. This is dangerous. In 2017, 939 people in the USA die because of this. That is 28% more than in 2012. In 35% of cases , the driver who runs the light dies. In more than 50% of cases, people in another car die. In 5% of cases, pedestrians and cyclists die. An American organization says that people must be more careful. People can check if no one is running a red light. Pedestrians and cyclists can make eye contact with the drivers of the cars. Difficult words: run a red light (drive instead of stopping), case (the situation when something happens), pedestrian (a person who is walking). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The League party, led by Interior Minister Matteo Salvini, is an Italian populist party which was in power. They were in coalition with the Five Star Movement whose Giuseppe Conte was the country’s prime minister. However, Salvini’s party withdrew from its power-sharing coalition and it shut down the government. Salvini then called a no-confidence vote against the prime minister. Many people saw this move as a way to force snap elections for Salvini to become prime minister. Prime Minister Conte resigned before the confidence vote could happen. The Italian president Sergio Mattarella consulted with the opposition Democratic Party and Five Star Movement leaders. While they were opponents in the past, they worked through their differenced and they agreed to form a new government. They agreed that Giuseppe Conte will be prime minister again. They now need to agree on policy and a team of ministers. Difficult words: no-confidence (a vote if the government is fit to be in power), snap (quick), policy (principle, plan of action). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The League party and the Five Star Movement ruled Italy by a coalition . Giuseppe Conte of the Five Star Movement was the prime minister. The League party quit the coalition and there was no government. Then it called for a no-confidence vote against the prime minister. Many people saw this as a move to make Matteo Salvini, the League party’s leader, prime minister. Prime Minister Conte resigned before the confidence vote could happen. Matteo Salvini did not become the new prime minister. In the end, the Five Star Movement made a coalition with the opposition Democratic Party, and Giuseppe Conte will still be prime minister. Difficult words: rule (make the rules, be the “boss”), coalition (when two parties work together), no-confidence (a vote if the government is fit to be in power). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Every country has a government . In Italy, the League party and the Five Star Movement are in a coalition . They are the government. Giuseppe Conte is the leader of the Five Star Movement. He is also the prime minister. Matteo Salvini is the leader of the League. However, the League party quits the coalition. There is no government now. Many people say that the League wants a new government where Salvini is the prime minister. He does not become the new prime minister. The Five Star Movement makes a new coalition with the Democratic Party. Giuseppe Conte stays prime minister. Difficult words: government (the group of people who are the “bosses” of a country), party (a group of politicians who work together because they want to do same things), coalition (a group of two or more parties which work together to make be a government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

According to the Centers for Disease Control (CDC), more than 200,000 people in the USA died from overdoses related to prescription opioids between 1999 and 2017. The Sacler family owns Purdue Pharma, and it is one of the companies who people are suing over its alleged contribution to the opioid epidemic. Newsy reported on Wednesday that Purdue, which is the producer of OxyContin, was willing to pay out $10 billion to $12 billion to settle the more than 2,000 lawsuits against it. The settlement means that people would restructure Purdue into a for-profit “public benefit trust.” The trust’s value would include more than $4 billion in drugs and profits from drug sales which would go to cities, counties and states. The Sacklers would also give up ownership of the company, and they would pay out at least $3 billion to the plaintiffs . Difficult words: alleged (when something is not 100% sure to be true), contribution (a part which makes something happen – the epidemic), settle (pay somebody money for something bad that you did), plaintiff (a person who comes to a court of law because somebody did something bad to him or her). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Difficult words: overdose (when you take too much of a drug and die), sue (go to a court of law and say that somebody did something wrong), contribution (a part which makes something happen), epidemic (a serious sickness that many people have). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
